scientific_integrity: The infinite arithmetic partition follows from the symbolic root and collision case analysis. Finite computations independently check representatives and selected finite fields; no computational extrapolation is used as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-round relational group language only. A complete finite-field case proof is provided; no higher-rank, arbitrary Frobenius-group or functional-language claim. Historical-literature coverage is not exhaustive.
title: Fifteen two-round theories of one-dimensional affine groups over finite fields
